cim: How to reverse engineer a website with AI
cim_eredeti: How to reverse engineer a website with AI
szoveg_eredeti: A seven-step method lets developers reverse engineer a website's UI using Chrome DevTools and an open-source coding-agent skill called /remix. The workflow finds the canvas or CSS behind an animation, checks whether it is WebGL or CSS, then runs /remix explain to break the effect into tweakable layers inside a free browser tool called Agent-Native Design. The author demonstrates it on Stripe's homepage wave, identifying the canvas as 'single-wave__canvas' and confirming WebGL via 'webgl2' returning true. /remix then rebuilds the effect in the user's own project using their brand's colors and code, without copying Stripe's assets. Builder.io's CEO Steve Sewell took apart Raycast, GSAP, and rauno.me with /remix.
